---
title: "Tucker's congruence coefficients"
format: pdf
---

```{r}
# Tucker's congruence coefficient
library(psych)
library(readxl)

pfa.short <- read_xlsx("pfa_emodistress_formH.xlsx", sheet="Pattern")
eifa.short <- read_xlsx("eifa_emodistress_formH.xlsx", sheet="Loadings")

pfa.short.loadings <- pfa.short[,c("ML1","ML2","ML3")]
eifa.short.loadings <- eifa.short[,c("F1","F2","F3")]

factor.congruence(pfa.short.loadings, eifa.short.loadings)



pfa.long <- read_xlsx("pfa_emodistress_full.xlsx", sheet="Pattern")
eifa.long <- read_xlsx("eifa_emodistress_full.xlsx", sheet="Loadings")

pfa.long.loadings <- pfa.long[,c("ML1","ML3","ML2")]
eifa.long.loadings <- eifa.long[,c("F1","F2","F3")]

factor.congruence(pfa.long.loadings, eifa.long.loadings)
```
